options.content:
### Artaban · AURA — Robot telemetry
`ROS 2 / Vulcanexus` → `Orion-LD (NGSI-LD, DDS bridge)` → `TROE · TimescaleDB` → `Mintaka` → **Grafana**  ·  Powered by FIWARE · ARISE all-in-one middleware  ·  [Open AURA dashboard (WireCloud) ↗](http://localhost:8000/admin/aura)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * (compound->>'percentage')::float AS "Battery"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/battery'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'operation_mode') AS "operation_mode"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'mission_state') AS "mission_state"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'gait') AS "gait"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'safety_state') AS "safety_state"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'mission_id') AS "mission"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'mission_progress')::float AS "Progress"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'current_waypoint') AS "wp"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN (compound->>'e_stop')::boolean THEN 'ENGAGED' ELSE 'released' END AS "E-stop"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Battery state of charge
panels.description: BatteryState.percentage; shaded bands follow the batteryLow alert thresholds

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", 100 * (compound->>'percentage')::float AS "SoC"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/battery' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'voltage')::float AS "Voltage", (compound->>'current')::float AS "Current"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/battery' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'voltage')::float * (compound->>'current')::float AS "Power", (compound->>'temperature')::float AS "Battery temp"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/battery' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Position trail · site map (60 × 40 m)
panels.description: Odometry pose (nav_msgs/Odometry) in the site frame over the selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (compound #>> '{pose,pose,position,x}')::float AS "x (m)", (compound #>> '{pose,pose,position,y}')::float AS "y (m)"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/odometry' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY ts

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound #>> '{twist,twist,linear,x}')::float AS "Speed"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/odometry' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", degrees(atan2(2 * ((compound #>> '{orientation,w}')::float * (compound #>> '{orientation,x}')::float + (compound #>> '{orientation,y}')::float * (compound #>> '{orientation,z}')::float), 1 - 2 * ((compound #>> '{orientation,x}')::float^2 + (compound #>> '{orientation,y}')::float^2))) AS "Roll", degrees(asin(greatest(-1, least(1, 2 * ((compound #>> '{orientation,w}')::float * (compound #>> '{orientation,y}')::float - (compound #>> '{orientation,z}')::float * (compound #>> '{orientation,x}')::float))))) AS "Pitch"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/imu' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'odometry_m')::float AS "Distance"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT (compound->>'odometry_m')::float AS "m"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound #>> '{twist,twist,linear,x}')::float AS "m/s"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/odometry'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Joint temperatures (latest)
panels.description: joint_names zipped with joint_temperatures — FL/FR/RL/RR legs × hip/thigh/calf actuators. Red > 70 °C triggers jointOverTemp.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT compound FROM attributes WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
), z AS (
  SELECT name.value AS n, (temp.value #>> '{}')::float AS t
  FROM s, jsonb_array_elements_text(s.compound->'joint_names') WITH ORDINALITY AS name(value, i)
  JOIN jsonb_array_elements(s.compound->'joint_temperatures') WITH ORDINALITY AS temp(value, i) USING (i)
)
SELECT max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'FL_hip') AS "FL hip",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'FL_thigh') AS "FL thigh",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'FL_calf') AS "FL calf",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'FR_hip') AS "FR hip",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'FR_thigh') AS "FR thigh",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'FR_calf') AS "FR calf",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'RL_hip') AS "RL hip",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'RL_thigh') AS "RL thigh",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'RL_calf') AS "RL calf",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'RR_hip') AS "RR hip",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'RR_thigh') AS "RR thigh",
  max(t) FILTER (WHERE n = 'RR_calf') AS "RR calf"
FROM z

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'max_joint_temperature')::float AS "Max joint temp"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'soc_temperature')::float AS "SoC temp"

WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Link quality
panels.description: commsDegraded fires at packet loss > 5 % or latency > 250 ms

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'link_latency_ms')::float AS "Latency", (compound->>'packet_loss')::float AS "Packet loss"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT (compound->>'wifi_rssi')::float AS "dBm"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:Robot:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Noise level (LAeq)
panels.description: EnvironmentReading.la_eq. > 75 dB degrades acoustic recognition; > 85 dB raises noiseHazard

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'la_eq')::float AS "LAeq", (compound->>'la_max')::float AS "LAmax"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:AirQualityObserved:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/reading' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gas (H₂S · CO · CH₄)
panels.description: AirQualityObserved.reading. gasDetected (critical) when H₂S > 10 ppm or CH₄ > 10 %LEL

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'h2s_ppm')::float AS "H₂S ppm", (compound->>'co_ppm')::float AS "CO ppm", (compound->>'ch4_lel')::float AS "CH₄ %LEL"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:AirQualityObserved:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/reading' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT (compound->>'o2_vol')::float AS "O₂"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:AirQualityObserved:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/reading'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'thermal_max')::float AS "°C"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:AirQualityObserved:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/reading'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'temperature')::float AS "°C"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:AirQualityObserved:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/reading'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'relative_humidity')::float AS "%"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:AirQualityObserved:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/reading'
